notes.title: Tarot Readings remium just got a major update 2.2.0
notes.notes:
--- 2.2.0 ---
* Added Touch-Screen support.
* Changed the font to a more modern.
* Fixed bug: Sometimes the cards were a little smaller on deck.
* Fixed bug: Some cards didnt have all the animations.
* Uses less memory and loads faster.
* Added 1 language: Japanese.
* Major game engine update.
* Graphics quality is a lot better.
* Other bugs fixed.

notes.title: 2.0.3 patch is live today.
notes.notes:
1) Fixed an bug that can freeze the game until prefs are deleted.
2) Fixed a bug displaying the wrong card.
3) Fixed German translation mistakes.
4) Fixed Portuguese translation mistakes.
5) Fixed problems with mixing Spanish and Italian translations.
6) Fixed issues with special characters not showing correctly.

notes.title: 2.0 Version is out! Its completely redesigned from scratch
notes.notes:
Version 2 is out.
1) Completely redesigned from scratch.
2) Exclusive custom 4K deck with animated cards!
3) 5 full decks of 78 cards. (1 animated and 4 historic: Grimaud, Conver, Dodal, Noblet)
4) Detailed or simple explanations for beginners.
5) Living room multiplayer!
6) Export outcome to your email.
7) Now is full of particles, effects and super polished.
8) Now up to 5 persons can be saved.
9) Many UI improvements.
10) Animation everywhere.
11) Translated into 8 languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Russian, Italian, Portuguese, Greek.
12) Runs on Linux 32bit/64bit, Windows 32bit/64bit, Mac OSX 64bit.
